fact: A committee formed under National Council for Public Freedoms and Human Rights decision 253 of 2023 is drafting a national personal data protection law, per the General Information Authority.
SMEX, citing the strategy, says the Data Protection and Privacy Law remains in draft, with adoption targeted for 2026.
SMEX says Libya currently has no functioning data protection authority.
The DPI Map country profile, last updated 1 October 2024, records no national data protection act for Libya.

Libya's National Council for Public Freedoms and Human Rights and a House of Representatives committee began a joint review on 26 October 2026 of a draft personal data protection law, prepared by the council's national committee over more than two and a half years with a Council of Europe-appointed expert's review and referred to the House as an initial proposal.
